messages:
Jordan H: Quick sync — I'm putting together a Datadog + OpenTelemetry deliverable for the Private marketplace listing. Main pieces: OTEL snippets, Datadog dashboard templates, and span/attribute mapping guidance.
Maya C: nice. Do we want separate templates for Dedicated vs Private?
Jordan H: Yes — Dedicated should include GPU-level metrics and model-serving spans; Private is more network/KMS-oriented.
Sanjay R: For tracing we need to standardize span names. Proposed minimal set: `redwood.request`, `redwood.model.generate`, `redwood.kv.cache.hit` and `redwood.kv.cache.miss`. Thoughts?
Emily L: +1 for those names. Also add `redwood.batch.window` for batching metrics so users can correlate token throughput.
Jordan H: Good call. I'll add `redwood.batch.window`. Also we need to map OpenTelemetry resource attributes to Datadog tags. Example mapping in docs: `service.name -> service`, `telemetry.sdk.name -> otel.sdk`, `deployment.environment -> env`.
datadog-bot: Integration smoke test: OTEL exporter -> Datadog OK (sampling: default). See https://app.datadoghq.com/integrations/otel-test-result
Maya C: For the marketplace listing copy — do we call out the dashboard pre-sets by workload? (chat, embeddings, rerank)
Jordan H: Yes. Three dashboard flavors: "chat (low-latency)" focusing on p95/p50 latency and prefix cache hit rate; "throughput (batch)" focusing on tokens/sec, batch sizes; "cost-ops" focusing on GPU utilization and quantization impact.
Sanjay R: Can we include a ready-to-drop OTEL collector config snippet for Private customers? I made a minimal example, feel free to copy:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DATADOG_API_KEY}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Emily L: That looks good. Add a note about setting `DD_TRACE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED` for automatic sampling in high-throughput setups.
Jordan H: Will do. For dashboards, I'll produce both JSON and a `datadog-dashboard-template.md` with recommended widgets and queries. Example widget query for model latency: `avg:trace.redwood.model.generate.latency{env:$env,service:$service} by {span_name}`
Maya C: Who's owning the marketplace listing copy? I can draft the legal/security blurb (KMS, VPC, compliance hints).
Jordan H: Please take copy. Sanjay can own the tracing mapping doc and Emily will own dashboard queries and widget descriptions. I'll own the OTEL snippets and the final zip for submission.
Sanjay R: Timeline?
Jordan H: Goal: first draft by EOD Friday (1785090000), internal review next week, partner review with Datadog the week after.
Emily L: I'll add example dashboard GIFs for the listing — quick visual sells.
Maya C: +1 on GIFs. Also suggest a short how-to: `1) enable OTEL exporter, 2) apply dashboard template, 3) set tags/env` — we should include a troubleshooting section for missing spans.
Jordan H: Good. Troubleshooting snippet to include: check OTEL exporter logs, ensure `service.name` is set, verify network egress to Datadog.
datadog-bot: Reminder: partner review window opens next Tue 09:00 UTC.
Jordan H: Awesome — will post a draft link when ready. If anyone has existing dashboard widgets they'd like included, drop them here or DM me. :thumbsup:
